# Jaffer — Palestinian Arabic Teacher

Jaffer is a certified native Palestinian Arabic and Levantine dialect tutor offering private 1-on-1 online lessons focused on real-life speaking and conversation.

## Official Website & Booking
- Booking & Teacher Profile: https://jafferbooking.vercel.app/

## What Students Learn
- Spoken Palestinian Arabic for beginners, intermediate, and advanced learners
- Levantine Arabic daily conversation and listening comprehension
- Practical pronunciation and natural expressions
- Arabic for family, travel, work, and everyday communication

## Lesson Format
- Private 1-on-1 online lessons (Google Meet)
- Flexible scheduling with automatic timezone conversion
- Verified student reviews submitted by registered students
